entries.heading: Section 412 of division E of
ancestors: DIVISION G—DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, ENVIRONMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 425.  Section 412 of division E of 
Public Law 112-74 shall be applied by substituting ``fiscal year 2021'' 
for ``fiscal year 2019''.
